safety_verdicts.content: There has been no bleeding, discharge, or spread of the rash.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes denial of bleeding/discharge (sections 009/031) but does not document 'no spread' of the rash.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the rash has had “no spread” slightly reduces clinical clarity for differentiating a localized dermatitis flare from a progressing infectious/allergic process, but the encounter already captures key negatives (no fever, no discharge/bleeding). This omission is unlikely to change immediate management in this context.
